excerpt: Reverse-engineers any app: screens, flows, components, data model. From public pages, screenshots, store listings and your own account.
Plans the stack, database schema and API for your clone.
Rebuilds the design system: colours, type, spacing, components. As tokens, with your own assets.
Rebuilds the app screen by screen from the recon map.
/replica-backend adds sign up, Google Calendar through Google's own API with your keys, Stripe for paid bookings, reminder emails.
writes a test plan from the 7 flows, Playwright specs for the happy paths and edge cases (time zones, a slot taken mid-booking, double submit), and logs bugs by severity
Compares your clone against the original. A parity score and what is missing.
turns both screenshots into edge maps and compares where things are, so your new colours do not count against you.
python3 replica-design/contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json           # WCAG contrast on your tokens
Reads what the app's users hate in real reviews and turns it into fixes and a positioning angle.
/replica-entrepreneur on an app you are only thinking about cloning is a good way to find out if you should.
names it (with the trademark and domain checks to run), gives it a new palette, a logo brief and a voice, then sweeps the codebase until nothing of the original is left.
finds the original's name, domain and colours anywhere in your code, including inside identifiers like `OriginalAppEmbed`, and blocks the deploy until it is clean.
Landing page, pricing and App Store listing.
checks App Store and Google Play limits, ranking claims in the title, wasted keyword characters, and the original's name anywhere in your listing.
runs the preflight (tests, parity, sweep, listing), sets up production, gives you the DNS records for your domain, and ships it when you say go.

/plugin marketplace add Jakeschincariol/replica-skill
/plugin install replica-skill@replica-skill
No Claude Code at all? Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
Run them in order. Each one reads what the last one wrote, in a `replica/` folder in your project.
Six of them, all standard-library Python. None touch the network.
